_comment: Input for the official pre-deployment validator from microsoft-foundry/foundry-samples:
Copy to params.json, edit, then run BEFORE terraform apply. The script never
touches Azure - it only calls your gateway - so it can run before any Foundry
Keep the values below in sync with environments/customer.tfvars:
NOTE: the parameter-file shape is NOT the connection metadata shape. Static
models live under 'staticModels' here but under 'models' in the connection,
and the discovery endpoints are three flat keys here rather than nested
inside 'modelDiscovery'. Copy from this file, not from the connection JSON.
The API key is deliberately absent - pass it with --api-key.

targetUrl._comment: Full chat completions URL minus /chat/completions (and minus /deployments/{name}).

authType._comment: ApiKey or OAuth2. OAuth2 also needs clientId, tokenUrl, scopes and --client-secret.

deploymentInPath._comment: false -> POST {targetUrl}/chat/completions with {"model": "<name>"} in the body. true -> {targetUrl}/deployments/<name>/chat/completions.

inferenceAPIVersion._comment: Appended as ?api-version=... Leave empty unless your gateway requires it. Kong does not.

staticModels._comment: 'name' is what gets sent as the model field and what --deployment-name must match. Leave version empty - it is appended to the model name in API calls.

authConfig._comment: Omit this block entirely to use the default 'api-key' header. Kong key-auth uses 'apikey'.
